dialogs.about_text:
👑 THE SETTLERS 6 • MOD & MAP MANAGER

Version: 1.1 (S6Patcher Edition)

Modern tool for managing configurations, game limits, scenario variants and test maps for The Settlers: Rise of an Empire.

Features:

  • Live XML Editor with Vanilla reference values & Lightroom Revert
  • Scenario Map Switcher with backup security
  • Sandbox Test Map Lua Injector
  • S6Patcher integrity control

Developed for the Settlers 6 Modding Community.
